data.description: Negative energy spreads out in all directions from the point of origin, dealing 1d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level [maximum +25] to nearby living enemies. Like other inflict spells, mass inflict light wounds cures undead in its area rather than damaging them. A cleric capable of spontaneously casting inflict spells can also spontaneously cast mass inflict spells.
